notes: Sourced from K-array's official datasheet (KA02_Datasheet_1.1.pdf) and user guide (KA02_uguide_1.1.pdf), both linked from the manufacturer product page. The user guide includes a numbered rear-panel connector diagram and a parts list of exact connector part numbers, giving high confidence on connector types and pin counts. Caveats: (1) The rear panel has an additional labeled port, "Remote control connector" (a wired-remote inlet, separate from the GPIO terminal), visible in the panel diagram but its physical connector type/pinout is not specified anywhere in the documentation, so it was omitted from the port list rather than guessed. (2) RJ45 Ethernet port speed/grade is not stated in either document, so grade was omitted (not assumed to be eth-1g). (3) TOSLINK, 3.5mm, Euroblock and DC-barrel connectors correctly have no grade set per the grading rules (analog/power/optical connectors aren't on the graded scales). (4) USB-A grade (usb-2.0) is explicitly stated in the datasheet ("4x USB-A 2.0"). (5) Device is a compact desktop unit (144 x 46 x 144 mm, 0.5kg); it is not inherently rack-mountable — an optional K-RACK2 accessory fits three KA02 units into 1U — so rackUnits was omitted per instructions for desktop units. (6) Datasheet v1.1 lists frequency response DSP as "96 kHz/32-bit" while the user guide's tech-spec table (also v1.1 wording in intro text) says "192 kHz/32-bit" for DSP processing; this discrepancy doesn't affect any port/connector data reported here.

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: 5-pin Phoenix MC 1.5/5-ST-3.81 terminal; supports up to 4 external normally-open switches + common ground, not general bidirectional GPIO

ports.name: Speaker Output CH1/CH2
ports.note: 4-pin Phoenix MSTB 2.5/4-ST-5.08 terminal carrying both channel 1 and channel 2 (SE 4Ω or PBTL 2Ω configurable)

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Powered by dedicated external AC/DC adapter: 100-240V AC 50-60Hz input, 24V 4A DC output
